powershell_cache_wrapper:
#!/bin/sh
export XDG_CACHE_HOME=/workspace/.cache
export XDG_DATA_HOME=/workspace/.local/share
export XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/workspace/.config
export DOTNET_CLI_HOME=/workspace/.dotnet-cli
exec /workspace/.powershell/7.5.4/pwsh "$@"
first_powershell_setup_failure: Read-only /home/agent/.cache/powershell; corrected by workspace XDG cache/data/config wrapper; no NC settings or source modified.
